subject: SIG delivery — redaction map, split exports, and staged portal upload sequence
messages:
From: Ethan Ward <eward@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG packet delivery — packaging expectations and portal notes

Hi Rachel / Ben,

Thanks again for taking the SIG request. Procurement at BlueWave has a couple of portal-specific asks before we start formal upload:

- They want evidence split into two payloads: a single flattened PDF bundle for Whistic and a folder of individual PDFs + manifest CSV for OneTrust.
- Sensitive items must be redacted at the PDF level (PII/PHI removed) and a separate redaction map provided mapping original file -> redaction ranges.
- Manifest must include a checksum (SHA256) per file and a simple classification column: SOC2 | SIG | CAIQ.
- They prefer staged uploads: first the questionnaire + manifest, then the evidence bundle within 24 hours to allow preliminary review.

Can you confirm Redwood can produce: (1) flattened PDF bundle (optimized for portal), (2) per-file CSV manifest with checksums, and (3) a redaction map CSV? Also please include estimated times for each deliverable.

Procurement contact is procurement@bluewavehealth.com — they have a scheduled intake window next week.

Best,
Ethan
Sourcing Manager
BlueWave Health
(attachment: example-portal-specs.pdf)

Ethan — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the asks; below is a proposed split of work, outputs, and timeline.

Plan (high level):
- Day 0 (today): Confirm scope and sample file set.
- Day 1: Produce filled SIG PDF + evidence extraction (individual PDFs).
- Day 2: Redaction pass (automated + manual review), generate redaction-map.csv and architecture-diagram-redacted.pdf.
- Day 3: Generate manifest (evidence-index_v1.csv) with SHA256 checksums and classification columns.
- Day 4: Create flattened Whistic bundle (SIG_Questionnaire_Filled.pdf + evidence flattened) and staged upload to OneTrust/Whistic per your sequence.

Deliverables we will attach to the portal:
- SIG_Questionnaire_Filled.pdf (flattened, signed)
- evidence-index_v1.csv (filename, checksum, classification, source-path)
- redaction-map.csv (original-filename, page-range, redaction-reason)
- individual redacted PDFs + architecture-diagram-redacted.pdf

Questions for procurement:
1) Any docs you explicitly want excluded from the bundle (e.g., raw HR spreadsheets)?
2) Do you require file-level metadata in a particular column order for your OneTrust ingestion?

Ben / Marissa — can you own extraction + checksum generation (Ben) and upload playbook + QA steps (Marissa)? I’ll own redaction coordination and the final staging.

Rachel

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG packet delivery — packaging expectations and portal notes

Folks — uploaded a short upload playbook for our prodops team and a checklist for portal QA. Key portal specifics I included:

- OneTrust: prefers individual files + manifest CSV; max single upload 2 GB; manifest header must include "file_name,sha256,classification" exactly.
- Whistic: accepts a single flattened PDF but will reject PDFs with embedded forms — we must flatten & flatten-embed fonts.
- Checksums: use lowercase hex, no 0x prefix.
- Staging sequence: questionnaire + manifest first, evidence bundle 24 hours later. Put a manifest version field (v1) so reviewers know this is the first submission.

I recommend we do a dry-run to the sandbox OneTrust instance (I included the sandbox link in the checklist). I’ll own the sandbox upload and QA.

(attachment: portal-upload-playbook.pdf)
